SharedFlowBundle.name: sf-audit-build
SharedFlowBundle.Description: Assembles the audit record into airlock.audit.* variables. Split from sf-audit-log because PostClientFlow -- where the record is written -- runs MessageLogging policies and nothing else: a JavaScript step placed there reports success and silently does nothing. So the record is built here, on the normal response path and on every fault path, and sf-audit-log reads the variables afterwards.
